0022600205.text: The Washington Wizards (4-6, 8th in the East) visit the Detroit Pistons (6-2, 1st in the Central) as they look to snap a three-game losing streak, and they have won only two of six road games so far. Washington is missing six players: Anthony Davis (ankle sprain), Deandre Ayton (leg), Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not played yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 Washington lost the season series 1-3, including a 117-95 loss in Washington on March 19, 2026.
